root_cause: The release chain proved client bearer wiring, protected portal tests, deployed function identity and live underlying data, but it had no autonomous real end-user Identity JWT to prove an authenticated HTTP 200 against /api/portal-ondernemersdata on the exact immutable production deploy.
prevention: Every production deploy affecting the Portal must create an exact-deploy authenticated proof receipt.
The proof must use a real short-lived Netlify Identity user JWT, never a service-role bypass or test header.
Synthetic Identity users must be deleted before a proof can become PROVEN.
Receipts must contain no token, password, synthetic email or user id.
Production readback must match both commit SHA and Netlify deploy id and fail closed on missing or stale proof.
Every netlify/functions/portal-* change must run in the protected Portal lane.
